LanguageData.DMSAC_Make_Molot.label: Gestate BR-3 "Molot"
LanguageData.DMSAC_Make_Molot.description: Gestate a BR-3 "Molot", the infantry combat platform of the ancient corps. Its production pattern was drawn up under the same main battle specification as the gravekeeper.
LanguageData.DMSAC_Make_Tsvetnik.label: Gestate SR-4/2B9 "Tsvetnik"
LanguageData.DMSAC_Make_Tsvetnik.description: Gestate an SR-4/2B9 "Tsvetnik", the mortar carrier of the ancient corps. Its production pattern was drawn up under the same main battle specification as the gravekeeper.
LanguageData.DMSAC_Make_Zabor.label: Gestate BR-4U "Zabor"
LanguageData.DMSAC_Make_Zabor.description: Gestate a BR-4U "Zabor", the ancient corps' mechanical infantry with extra frontal armor. Its production pattern was drawn up under the same main battle specification as the gravekeeper.
LanguageData.DMSAC_Make_Gorod.label: Gestate BR-4 "Gorod"
LanguageData.DMSAC_Make_Gorod.description: Gestate a BR-4 "Gorod", the heavily armored mechanical infantry of the ancient corps. Its production pattern was drawn up under the same main battle specification as the gravekeeper.
LanguageData.DMSAC_Make_Krepost.label: Gestate BR-6 "Krepost"
LanguageData.DMSAC_Make_Krepost.description: Gestate a BR-6 "Krepost", the huge walker the ancient corps fielded as a bridgehead and mobile battery. Its production pattern was drawn up under the same main battle specification as the gravekeeper.
LanguageData.DMSAC_Make_Pravda.label: Gestate 2S95 "Pravda"
LanguageData.DMSAC_Make_Pravda.description: Gestate a 2S95 "Pravda", the all-terrain assault gun the ancient corps built to shell fortifications from long range. Its production pattern was drawn up under the same main battle specification as the gravekeeper.
